subject.title: fix(google): add timeout to Vertex ADC token refresh

question: Should Google Vertex authorized_user ADC token refresh use this fixed 30s deadline, or should it inherit an existing provider/request timeout before merge?
rationale: The code path is correct for the reported hang, but the new fail-fast auth behavior is an intentional operator-visible timeout contract.

options.title: Land the 30s ADC deadline
options.body: Accept the narrow switch from unbounded authorized_user OAuth refresh to a 30s timeout once exact-head checks remain acceptable.

options.title: Ask for inherited timeout wiring
options.body: Require the token refresh to use an existing provider/request timeout contract if fixed 30s is not the desired operator behavior.

options.title: Pause for broader Vertex auth reliability
options.body: Hold this branch if maintainers want token refresh deadlines, response limits, stale-token retry, and retry behavior landed through one coordinated Google Vertex reliability path.

recommendation.title: Land the 30s ADC deadline
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow switch from unbounded authorized_user OAuth refresh to a 30s timeout once exact-head checks remain acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current routing signal is recent merged/reviewed Google Vertex ADC hardening around this exact file and token-refresh boundary.
